# UK Home Affordability Calculator

> Interactive programmatic calculator for UK mortgage limits, deposit requirements, and stamp duty by profession and location.

## Core Features

- [Main Calculator](https://www.affordabilitycalculator.co.uk/): Calculate home affordability based on salary and region.
- [Professions Hub](https://www.affordabilitycalculator.co.uk/professions/): Search salary bands and borrowing limits across UK occupations.
- [Locations Hub](https://www.affordabilitycalculator.co.uk/locations/): View average property prices and regional tax thresholds across the UK.

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.affordabilitycalculator.co.uk/privacy/): Information on analytics and data handling.
